title: AI red-teaming is a sociotechnical problem: on values, labor, and harms
findings: The paper does not present findings related to religion in AI. The only mention of religion is a historical analogy on page 2, where the practice of the 13th-century Catholic church establishing a 'Devil's Advocate' to interrogate nominees for sainthood is cited as an early form of adversarial testing, a precursor to modern red-teaming.
